close_reason: Added require_tls: bool to EnvelopeFile with serde(default); added require_tls param to enqueue(); used envelope.require_tls in try_deliver_one() instead of hardcoded false. Backward compat for old envelope files. 2 new tests.
description: EnvelopeFile (relay_queue.rs:33-36) has only mail_from and rcpt_to — no require_tls field. SessionState::Mail also lacks the field. Result: when MAIL FROM with REQUIRETLS arrives over TLS, the flag is validated (correctly rejected on non-TLS) but never stored. At DATA time, sieve_delivery sees no require_tls context; the RelayEnvelope built at drain time has require_tls=false. RFC 8689's guarantee that every downstream hop enforces TLS is silently dropped after the first queue-persist.
title: require_tls flag not persisted in relay queue EnvelopeFile
